candidates.title: Multi-unit inertial fusion plants based on HYLIFE-II, with shared heavy-ion RIA driver and target factory, producing electricity and hydrogen fuel
candidates.notes: 1994 LLNL report extending HYLIFE-II economics to multi-unit plants with shared RIA driver and target factory. Economic analysis via IFEFUEL2 code, covering cost of electricity and hydrogen. NOT a modern update — from the same HYLIFE-II era as existing sources. Partially addresses G-1 by adding multi-unit economics not in current source set, but does not satisfy the need for modern (post-2000) dollar analysis.

candidates.title: Extension of the Fusion Power Plant Costing Standard
candidates.notes: 2026 paper on IFE/MFE/MIFE costing framework (probabilistic layer, NPV/IRR/LCOE metrics). Full-text confirmed via WebFetch: covers laser IFE and tokamak/MFE only. No heavy ion beam ICF content. Framework paper, not HIF cost data.

candidates.title: A simplified economic model for inertial fusion
candidates.notes: 2020 Phil Trans Royal Society A paper. Technology-agnostic IFE model in principle, but full text confirmed via WebFetch: only laser ICF and pulsed power receive specific analysis. No HIF driver cost data. Not useful for HIF CAPEX gap.

failed.reason: Extraction timed out after 600 seconds — OSTI PDF is a scanned (image-based) document. The agentic-mbse extraction pipeline requires OCR/LLM processing which exceeded the 10-minute timeout. Content confirmed accessible via WebFetch but returned binary image data only.

gaps_attempted.notes: G-1 is a structural gap: no modern (post-2000) HIF economic analysis exists in accessible literature. The gap description itself acknowledges this: 'no published modern study exists.' The closest candidate (OSTI 10170594, 1994) extends HYLIFE-II economics to multi-unit plants but adds no modern dollar values. Extraction failed due to scanned PDF timeout. Future iterations should attempt direct PDF ingestion with higher timeout budget or request access via OSTI contact.

candidates.title: FLIBE USE IN FUSION REACTORS: AN INITIAL SAFETY ASSESSMENT (OSTI, 1999)
candidates.notes: 1999 INEEL safety assessment of FLiBe in fusion reactors. May contain inventory estimates but predates modern Be supply chain context. Deprioritized as too old to address the gap.

gaps_attempted.notes: No accessible modern FLiBe cost-per-kg data found. The most promising candidate (Tandf 2019 article) is paywalled. The gap remains open. Kairos Power is developing industrial FLiBe supply chains for the FHR; contacting Kairos or searching for their procurement documentation may be a future avenue.

candidates.title: Review of Heavy-Ion Inertial Fusion Physics
candidates.notes: 2015 peer-reviewed review paper (Kawata, Karino, Ogoyski; published in Matter and Radiation at Extremes). 21 pages with 36 figures. Covers state-of-the-art HIF physics including target gain requirements (~50–70 for 1 GWe plant), robust target implosion analysis, and fuel target physics. Most recent comprehensive HIF physics review found. More current than 1985–1994 HIBALL/HYLIFE-II simulations.

candidates.title: Direct Drive Heavy-Ion-Beam Inertial Fusion at High Coupling Efficiency
candidates.notes: 2007 OSTI conference paper. Contains LASNEX simulations of direct-drive HIF targets at high coupling efficiency (16–18% shell kinetic energy/beam energy when ion range increases fourfold). Coupling efficiency data, not gain calculations per se. No free full-text PDF confirmed accessible. Deprioritized vs. arxiv 1511.06508.

gaps_attempted.gap_description: sCO₂ or advanced power conversion cycle evaluation for HIF
gaps_attempted.notes: WebSearch budget exhausted (5/5 searches used) before reaching this gap. The gap description notes that 'no published study exists' for sCO₂ evaluation in HIF context — this is likely a truly vacant gap in the literature. A targeted search for 'sCO₂ inertial fusion energy power conversion' or 'supercritical CO2 IFE heat exchanger' may find adjacent studies, but a specific HIF sCO₂ paper is unlikely to exist given the hiatus of the HIF program.

gaps_attempted.gap_description: HIBALL or HYLIFE-II updated with modern Li-6 enrichment and beryllium supply chain constraints
gaps_attempted.notes: Nice-to-have priority. WebSearch budget exhausted before reaching this gap. Supply chain analysis for Li-6 enrichment and beryllium in modern context would likely be found in broader fusion materials supply chain literature, not in HIF-specific publications.

summary.notes: G-1 (modern CAPEX) is a structural gap — the literature contains no modern HIF economic analysis. The gap cannot be closed by source acquisition alone; it requires a new modeling exercise. G-8 (modern target gain) was closed with the 2015 Kawata et al. HIF physics review. G-5 (FLiBe cost) had no accessible sources. G-10 and G-14 were skipped due to budget exhaustion.
